summary: Copy enumerable own string and Symbol properties in ECMAScript key order with Get/Set side effects.

semantics.keys: own enumerable string and Symbol keys, OwnPropertyKeys order
semantics.side_effects: source getters and target setters are invoked
semantics.failure: abrupt completion leaves earlier writes applied

caveats: Dictionary assignment misses Symbol keys, property order, accessors, and partial mutation on failure.
Proxy traps require full runtime behavior.

tests.name: getter then throwing setter leaves prior mutation
tests.input: const t={a:0}; Object.defineProperty(t,'b',{set(){throw 7}}); try{Object.assign(t,{a:1,b:2,c:3})}catch(e){} console.log(t.a,'c' in t);
